outside15.
Open work. Visible evidence.

A small AI task. Checks you can inspect.

Outside15 keeps the outdoor break simple. Behind the return screen, a local agent organizes the observation, checks its evidence, and hands control back to the person.

Eight focused English regression cases. Results reflect each run’s model and validation path; they are not a general model benchmark. These runs used different integration paths, so they are development evidence rather than a controlled model comparison.

GitHub Actions · Test before deploy

A broken check stops Pages deployment.

Python validation → Mastra failure tests → browser flows → static build → repository-subpath and offline checks → GitHub Pages deployment.

Workflow implemented and checked with local equivalents. A successful hosted Actions run is still required after pushing to your repository. Live inference is verified locally and excluded from hosted CI.
